vo_open.text: This jockey won the first race of his life.

vo.text: June fourth, 1923. Frank Hayes, twenty-two, rides a horse called Sweet Kiss.
Sweet Kiss was a twenty-to-one outsider. Hayes had never won a race.
vo.cap: A *20-to-1* outsider. Hayes had *never won* a race.

vo.text: Late in the race, Hayes had a heart attack. But his body stayed in the saddle.
vo.cap: Late in the race: a *heart attack.* His body *stayed in the saddle.*

vo.text: Sweet Kiss crossed the line first. Nobody noticed, until they came to congratulate him.
vo.cap: She crossed the line *first.* Nobody noticed... until they came to *congratulate him.*

vo.text: The horse never raced again. People called her: Sweet Kiss of Death.
vo.cap: She never raced again. They called her: *Sweet Kiss of Death.*
